theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_good_point_monotonicity
theorems.statement: MonotonicityFormula → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (y : Euclidean N) (ε Λ : ℝ), W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ball y 1 ⊆ U → 0 ≤ ε → W.weight (ball y 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → variationMeasure W (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * W.weight (closedBall y ρ)) → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (ε * ρ)) * W.weight (closedBall y ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (Ioo 0 1) ∧ (∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n W.weight y θ ∧ θ ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → θ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (ε * σ)) * densityRatio n W.weight y σ) ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → W.weight (closedBall y σ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ε * Λ * σ ^ n)
